about: The approval card air control raises when a pilot’s write is held for a human. A server whose write tool takes a boolean `dryRun` is asked for a preview first (the same call, dryRun:true); it may answer with `preview` below, and the card then shows the server’s own before → after instead of flightdeck’s derivation. Answering with anything else falls back, and the card says so.

summary.description: one plain sentence a human judges the write by — "Change the class on deposit #1131 — $484.40 from …"

value.description: what it reads once the write has run (for an unchanged field, what it reads now)

from.description: CHANGED fields only: what it reads now, before the write

changed.description: true when this write changes the field; the card highlights it as from → value

fields.description: the record before → after, in the order a bookkeeper reads it

link.description: the record's own page in the server's product

billing.description: true only for a paid-billing card (#2129), which is drawn differently

recommend.description: the option to mark recommended, or null — a card nobody can read is never recommended

question.description: the headline: what the write will do, in one sentence

why.description: the pilot's own reason, the record's memo, or a plain admission that there is none

value.description: what it reads once the write has run (for an unchanged field, what it reads now)

from.description: CHANGED fields only: what it reads now, before the write

changed.description: true when this write changes the field; the card highlights it as from → value

link.description: https link to the record, or ''

note.description: facts about the CARD itself — which tool is held, whose preview this is, what could not be read

what.description: what pressing it does to THIS record

example.summary: Change the class on deposit #1131 — $484.40 from Blue Sombrero Sports Connect into Chase Checking on Aug 19, 2026
